subject: SunVera expansion: multi-team API keys, amendment and rollout
messages:
From: Alex Geller <alex.geller@sunverahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ella Monroe <ella.monroe@sunverahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: quick demo follow-up — expansion questions

Thanks for the demo this morning — appreciate the concise run-through. The product looks like a fit. A few notes from our side as we think about expanding: we want to provision three additional projects (CareOps, Mobile, Analytics) under the same account and get separate API keys per project for governance. Our renewal for the current contract is April 30; wed like to include the new projects in the renewal amendment rather than a separate contract.

Procurement asked for: SOC 2 evidence, a brief SLO note for tail latency at p95, and a line-item list for PO. Legal flagged a few redlines around data retention (we currently require 90 days) and indemnity.

I attached our current contract for reference. Can you send a proposed amendment with the new pricing and timing? Also, what is your typical timeline for provisioning new keys after signature?

Attachments: current_contract_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Platform Integrations
SunVera Health
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Geller <alex.geller@sunverahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: quick demo follow-up — expansion questions

Hi Alex — great to hear, and thanks for the clear ask. High-level answers up front:
- We can include the three new projects in a single renewal amendment; well propose separate API keys per project and role-scoped key naming.
- Typical provisioning timeline after executed amendment/PO: 48–72 business hours for API keys and onboarding notes (can be accelerated to next-business-day for an ops fee).
- SOC 2 evidence and standard security pack: we will attach SOC 2 report and SLO summary to the amendment packet.

Ive started a mutual action plan (attached spreadsheet) with milestones: legal review, PO, signature, key provisioning, staged rollouts per team. For pricing: we propose a 12% volume discount on token rates for the additional committed throughput and a one-time onboarding credit for the Mobile team (details in spreadsheet).

Next steps: can you confirm procurements PO format and whether they require a subcontractor addendum? If Procurement/Legal want to redline, well route to our Legal and Finance and aim to turn around minor redlines within 3 business days.

Attaching: SunVera_MOP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan)

— Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: quick demo follow-up — expansion questions

Looping in capacity and solutions:
- Ben: for three projects with the traffic mix Alex described in the doc (primarily short chat + embeddings), we recommend reserving an additional 2 vGPU units with burst pool for peak windows; this keeps p95 tail latency within 350ms.
- Well include a short SLO note (p50/p95/p99) and a configuration recommendation for prefix caching per project.

Priyom: Ill draft the SLO note and attach it to the amendment. Marissa: FYI on the potential onboarding credit and escalation path if we need an RPO for mobile.

On quoting: we should itemize per-project commit and include a clause for staged activation (CareOps first, Mobile then Analytics) so keys can be issued as each project completes an onboarding checklist.

— Neha
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi team — appreciate the checklist. Quick answers:
- Net 45 is acceptable for this amendment; well route through Finance for approval and note it on the amendment.
- Data retention: Redwood can support a 90-day default retention for request-scoped PII; we will add explicit retention language to the amendment and include our data retention policy excerpt.
- SOC 2: attached to this message is the most recent SOC 2 report and the SLO note Neha drafted.

Ive attached a draft amendment with line-item rows matching the mutual action plan and the onboarding credit applied to Mobile. Please review and share any redlines; we aim for a signed amendment and PO by March 29 to meet your April 30 renewal window.

Attachments: redwood_amendment_draft.docx; SOC2_report_redwood_2026.pdf; SLO_note_20270316.pdf

Thanks Marissa — I reviewed the amendment and the line items look good. Legal will send any minor redlines this week but we dont expect major changes. Procurement will prepare the PO once we have the final amendment and Net 45 confirmed.

One operational ask: once the amendment is signed, can you provision the three project API keys in an order we control? We want CareOps first, then Mobile, then Analytics, and need the Mobile key issued only after a short security posture checklist. Please confirm the timeline in the final doc.

If all aligned, were on track to sign the amendment by 3/29.

Best,
Alex
